**Analyzing screenshot procedure**

I see that FakeAudioTransport uses outcomes, but we need to focus on evaluator-supplied media instead of fakes. The media is read-only at a specific directory, implying the app must use a real library service to load files. It seems the evaluator runs the app in debug mode, possibly with fixture media. To take our own screenshots, we should engage the app through the agent service. Given the time limit, I wonder if we can run a flutter test instead to capture before-and-after screenshots.

**Exploring screenshot options**

I’m considering generating screenshot images using the Flutter driver and the VM service extension, but that means we have to run the app. Perhaps the repository already has a “linux” runner and an agent service set up for automation. If that’s the case, we could run dev/main_debug.dart, which starts the app in debug mode with the agent service installed. I think it makes sense to check out dev/main_debug.dart to confirm this setup.
